# Third-party methods used in the comparison (not included)

`experiments/matlab/setup_paths.m` and `setup_paths_new.m` expect these folders here:

| folder | method | source |
|---|---|---|
| `Enhanced-3DTV/` | E-3DTV | https://github.com/andrew-pengjj/Enhanced-3DTV |
| `FastHyMix/` (with `scripts/`, `BM3D/`) | FastHyMix | https://github.com/LinaZhuang/HSI-MixedNoiseRemoval-FastHyMix |
| `L1HyMixDe/` (with `L1HyMixDe/`, `BM3D/`) | L1HyMixDe | https://sites.google.com/hkbu.edu.hk/linazhuang/home |
| `S3TTV/` (with `sub_functions/`) | S3TTV | https://www.mdi.c.titech.ac.jp/publications/s3ttv |

FastHyMix and L1HyMixDe need BM3D v2 (Tampere University) in their `BM3D/` folders, as their READMEs explain.
